meta.title: StarCraft II Ground-Truth Timings & Costs Database

field_glossary.supply: supply cost (Zerglings 0.5 each; supply providers have supply 0 and provides_supply>0)
field_glossary.bt_faster: build/train/morph time in FASTER real-time seconds (what the in-game clock shows; use this for build-order math)
field_glossary.bt_normal: build time in NORMAL game-seconds (raw data value) = bt_faster * 1.399902
field_glossary.rt_faster: research time in FASTER real-time seconds
field_glossary.req: tech prerequisites that must exist first
field_glossary.morph_from: unit/building this is morphed from (source is consumed or transformed)
field_glossary.provides_supply: supply this structure/unit adds to your cap
field_glossary.at: structure the upgrade is researched at

time_convention.rule: Build/research times are stored internally in NORMAL game-seconds. The game DISPLAYS real-time seconds; on 'Faster' (ladder/tournament standard) the in-game clock ALSO runs in real-time. So faster_s = normal_s / 1.399902343750 (~/1.4). Build-order timestamps (mm:ss) and all in-game readouts are FASTER seconds. Primary column for planning = *_faster.
time_convention.liquipedia_caveat: Liquipedia is INTERNALLY INCONSISTENT: the Unit Statistics page and upgrade pages list FASTER values; the Building Statistics page lists NORMAL values. All values below are normalized so bt_faster/rt_faster is always the real-time (displayed) number.
time_convention.building_fix_2026_07_05: Building bt values were double-converted (real-time values had been labeled normal and divided again). Fixed: bt_faster now holds the real-time/Faster value, bt_normal recomputed as faster*1.399902. Empirically verified against a 5.0.16 EU ladder replay (2026-07-04): observed Pylon 17.9f, Gateway 46.4f, Cybernetics Core 35.7f, Stargate 42.9f, Nexus 71.4f, Assimilator 21.4f, Shield Battery 28.6f, Forge 32.1f, Fleet Beacon 42.9f, Robotics Facility 46.4f — all matching the corrected bt_faster. Unit times were already correct (observed Probe 12f, Stalker 27f, Oracle 37f). bt_normal snapped to the nearest multiple of 5 when within 1 (canonical Normal times are 5-multiples: CC 100, Barracks 65, Depot 30).

provenance_notes: Patch values: Blizzard 5.0.17 notes and Liquipedia Patch 5.0.17 agree line for line (checked 2026-10-21). Liquipedia unit pages are stale (pre-5.0.14 numbers) and were not used.

Checked against Dante's 5.0.17 ladder replay (Rust Bucket 2v2, 2026-10-20, build 98310): 12 workers and 12/15 supply at 0:00 (Zerg 12/14); warp-ins 3.6s (275 cases) and 11.4s (12 cases); a Gateway after Warp Gate research trains a Stalker every 27.1s, so the speedup is gone.
Chrono Boost 20s Faster: in a 5.0.15-rules replay a Nexus chronoed at 0:11.5 produced boosted Probes until 0:31.4 (19.9s).

Mining rates: median replay Collection Rate over 84 replays from 2026-08-25, one base and no gas, about 49 minerals per worker-minute up to 19 workers (Faster); saturated geysers cluster at 156-167 gas/min each. Per-trip yields did not change in 5.0.17.
Unit costs/supply/times: Liquipedia Unit Statistics (Faster) reconciled with patch notes. Building costs/times: Liquipedia Building Statistics (Normal, converted to Faster).
Weapon/armor upgrade bt_normal values are back-computed (faster*1.4) and may differ +/-1s from the exact catalog integer.
Combat stats (hp/shield/armor/attributes) are supplementary; for exhaustive combat data consult Liquipedia unit pages, which are currently stale.
verify_flags: High/Dark Templar Gateway train time 40s: from the 30 Jun 2026 hotfix; 5.0.17 notes are silent. Pre-5.0.16 value was 39 per Liquipedia. Check the first Gateway-trained Templar in a replay.
Gateway/Warp Gate transform duration 4s both ways: from 5.0.16b; 5.0.17 notes are silent (5.0.15 was 7s/5s).
Rich vespene return per trip 6: from 5.0.16; 5.0.17 notes are silent (5.0.15 was 8).
Shield Battery starting energy: 5.0.17 says 100 near a Nexus, otherwise 50.
Worker mining rates are replay-calibrated medians, not engine constants; they include workers walking to build.
patch_history: 5.0.16 hotfix 2026-06-30 (geyser 2000, larva 9.9, Reaper 34, Adept 33, HT/DT 40, Mothership 200/400; missed by this DB until 2026-10-21)
5.0.17 live 2026-10-07 NA/KR, 2026-10-08 EU, build 98310 (rolls most of 5.0.16 back to 5.0.15)
meta.revision_note: Updated 2026-10-21 to 5.0.17, which reverts most of 5.0.16. Economy: 12 starting workers, large/small patch 1800/900, geyser 2250 (4500 per base). Supply: CC/Orbital/PF/Nexus 15, Hatchery/Lair/Hive 6 (cost 275). Command Center 400, Planetary Fortress 150/150. Warp Gate: research no longer speeds Gateway production; transform free; warp-in 3.6s in a fast field, 11.4s in a slow one; cooldowns Zealot/Adept 20, Stalker/Sentry 23, HT/DT 32. Adept 30s and +1(+1 vs Light) per upgrade; Psi Storm 110; Colossus 10(+5 vs Light); Mothership 350/350; Disruptor phantom weapon removed; Forcefield breaks to one Bile. Ghost HP 125, 10(+10 vs Light), range 6, Steady Targeting 130(+40 vs Psionic) for 50 energy; Widow Mine delay 1.07s; Reaper 32s. Zerg: larva 10.7s, Carapace 150/200/250, Microbial Shroud needs research again (range 9), Infestor weapon removed, Spore +10 vs Biological, Overlord 0.9, creep 0.45s, Viper Abduct cannot target Siege Tanks, Mutalisk arc 45. Also fixed two pre-existing errors found against replays: Chrono Boost lasts 20s Faster (was stored as 14.3), and mining/gas rates recalibrated from 84 replays. High/Dark Templar Gateway time 40s carried from the 30 Jun 2026 hotfix, which 5.0.17 does not mention.

game_speed.clock: On Faster the in-game match clock runs in real-time, so clock seconds ARE faster-seconds: 1:00 on the clock = 60 faster-s. bt_faster values therefore align directly with build-order mm:ss.

start.note: 5.0.17 restored 12 starting workers (5.0.16 had 8). Terran/Protoss cap 15 = Command Center/Nexus. Zerg cap 14 = Hatchery 6 + starting Overlord 8. Verified in a 5.0.17 replay.

mining.third_worker_per_patch_marginal: roughly half of the first two (~a saturated 3-worker patch ~2.5x a 1-worker patch)
mining.approx_minerals_per_worker_per_min_faste: ~49 per worker up to 16 on a base; workers 17-24 add ~35 each (replay medians, 84 games)
mining.note: Rates are Faster (in-game clock) per-minute medians of the replay Collection Rate stat, which integrates to within ~5% of actual mined totals. They include workers temporarily walking to build. Per-trip yield unchanged since 5.0.15.

ChronoBoost.note: +50% speed for 20s on the in-game clock, so 30s of work finishes in 20s. Replay-verified (19.9s). The DB previously stored 14.3s, which was wrong.

WarpGate.transform_note: 4s both ways since 5.0.16b; 5.0.17 notes are silent (verify).
WarpGate.gateway_production_speedup: None. 5.0.17 removed it (5.0.16 40%, 5.0.16b 50%). A Gateway trains at the base bt_faster whether or not the research is done; replay-verified 27.1s Stalker after research.
WarpGate.fast_field: A Pylon power field near a Nexus or a Warp Gate, or a phasing Warp Prism. Anywhere else is slow.
WarpGate.note: The cooldown runs during the warp-in, so a Warp Gate cycle equals its cooldown: Zealot every 20s against a Gateway's 27s, Stalker every 23s against 27s. Replay-verified: Stalker rounds 24s apart from the same Warp Gates. Chrono Boost speeds the cooldown. Transform as soon as the research lands.

base_larva_spawn.note: 5.0.17 restored 10.7s (5.0.16 9.5, 30 Jun hotfix 9.9). Natural spawn stops at 3 larvae; inject can exceed.

benchmarks.note: Community/empirical reference landmarks in the FASTER in-game clock (mm:ss). Use to sanity-check computed timings. Travel-dependent events (proxy hits) vary with map/spawn distance.
